info.title: ROS OCP Backend API
info.description: GO Echo API for Resource Optimization OCP Backend Service

get.description: This feature is in limited preview for select customers. Refer to [this link](https://github.com/RedHatInsights/ros-ocp-backend/blob/main/openapi.json) if you want checkout the OpenAPI spec file.

externalDocs.description: Please refer to this blog post if you want to be included in the preview

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Used as a fallback when the 'Accept' header is missing or specifies an unsupported media type.  
Maximum number of records is 1000 i.e. 6000 rows for CSV downloads.  
The 'offset' parameter can be used for pagination with both formats.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Partial match on cluster alias, exact match on cluster UUID

parameters.name: exclude[cluster]
parameters.description: Exclude cluster by alias or UUID

parameters.name: filter[exact:cluster]
parameters.description: Exact match on cluster alias or UUID

parameters.name: true-units
parameters.description: Shows all values in true/real-world units. Accepts 1, t, T, TRUE, true, True, 0, f, F, FALSE, false, False.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field to order results by. Variation values are percent of current CPU or memory request (float); see the recommendations.variation amounts in each list item.

parameters.name: has_gpu
parameters.description: Filter by GPU presence. 'true' or '1' returns only containers with GPU data; 'false' or '0' returns only containers without GPU data.

parameters.name: gpu_model
parameters.description: Filter by GPU model name (case-insensitive substring match, e.g. 'A100', 'T4'). Repeatable for OR logic.

parameters.name: gpu_classification
parameters.description: Filter by GPU workload classification (case-insensitive substring match). Repeatable for OR logic. Values: idle, underutilized, compute_bound_underutil, memory_bound, well_utilized.

400.description: Bad request, e.g. invalid query parameter value

message.example: invalid workload_type "not-a-real-type", must be one of: daemonset, deployment, deploymentconfig, replicaset, replicationcontroller, statefulset

schema.example: User is not authorized to access the resource

503.description: Service unavailable due to a database error

error.example: unable to fetch records from database

get.description: Returns the current recommendation term configuration for the caller's org. If no custom terms have been set, returns the defaults (short=1d, medium=7d, long=15d).

put.description: Replace the recommendation term configuration for the caller's org. Each term must have a name (short, medium, or long), window_days (1-90), and optionally decay_halflife_hours. Changes take effect on the next engine processing cycle.

delete.summary: Reset recommendation term settings to defaults
delete.description: Removes any custom term configuration for the caller's org, reverting to the built-in defaults (short=1d, medium=7d, long=15d).

get.description: Returns paginated recommendation snapshots over time. Each row represents a recommendation that was computed for a specific container, term, and engine at a specific point in time. Only available when the native engine is enabled.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of date range filter on recorded_at (inclusive). Defaults to first day of current month.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of date range filter on recorded_at (inclusive). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Filter by cluster alias (exact match, repeatable)

parameters.name: workload
parameters.description: Filter by workload name (exact match, repeatable)

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Filter by container name (exact match, repeatable)

get.description: Returns GPU time-slicing recommendations aggregated at the node level. Each recommendation suggests a `nvidia.com/gpu.replicas` value that would allow multiple underutilized workloads to share the same physical GPU via NVIDIA time-slicing.

parameters.name: node_name
parameters.description: Filter by node name (case-insensitive substring match)

parameters.name: gpu_model
parameters.description: Filter by GPU model name (case-insensitive substring match)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Use -1 to return all results.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort field. Allowed values: node_name, cluster_uuid, gpu_model, recommended_replicas, confidence, total_node_savings

message.example: Workload is optimised wrt CPU REQUESTS, no changes needed
Workload is optimised wrt CPU LIMITS, no changes needed
Workload is optimised wrt MEMORY REQUESTS, no changes needed
Workload is optimised wrt MEMORY LIMITS, no changes needed

GPURecommendation.description: GPU-specific recommendation data. Present only for containers with attached GPU resources.

current_gpu_profile.description: Current MIG profile name, or null for full GPU

gpu_classification.description: Utilization classification based on DCGM profiling metrics. Empty if profiling data unavailable (Tier 2 GPUs).

recommended_gpu_profile.description: Recommended MIG profile, 'full_gpu', or null if no change recommended

memory_bound_detected.description: True when DRAM bandwidth is saturated but tensor cores are underutilized

gpu_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the GPU recommendation

tensor_pipe_active_avg.description: Average tensor core utilization (0.0-1.0) across observation window

dram_active_avg.description: Average DRAM bandwidth utilization (0.0-1.0) across observation window

sm_active_avg.description: Average streaming multiprocessor activity (0.0-1.0) across observation window

fb_usage_max_mib.description: Peak frame buffer usage in MiB across observation window

estimated_monthly_gpu_savings_usd.description: Estimated monthly GPU cost savings from idle removal or MIG right-sizing, in USD. Null if no cost data available.

estimated_monthly_timeslicing_savings_us.description: Estimated monthly savings if GPU time-slicing is enabled on the node. Represents this container's share (savings_per_gpu from the node recommendation). Only set for time-slicing candidate containers with cost data available.

time_slicing_node.description: Node name where GPU time-slicing is recommended. Present only for containers that are time-slicing candidates (notification code 29).

time_slicing_replicas.description: Recommended nvidia.com/gpu.replicas value (2-8) for the target node. Present only for containers that are time-slicing candidates (notification code 29).

count.description: Total number of matching results (before pagination)
